title: Domain Controller Unreachable
summary: Users cannot authenticate; GPO and DNS may be impacted.
steps: Confirm scope — one DC or entire site?
Ping and Test-NetConnection to DC IP on port 389/636
Check hypervisor host health if virtualized
Console or iLO/KVM — safe mode / recovery
Verify AD replication partners if partial outage
Fail DNS to secondary DC if needed
Document timeline and open change if rebuild required

title: Certificate Expiring < 14 Days
summary: Prevent service outage from expired TLS or code-signing cert.
steps: Identify cert thumbprint, SANs, and binding (IIS, LB, API)
Check if auto-renew is enabled (ACME, internal CA template)
Schedule maintenance window if manual bind required
Request/reissue cert from PKI team or vendor portal
Deploy to all nodes in the farm — verify chain
Run SSL Labs or openssl s_client smoke test
Update cert inventory in team tracker

title: Disk Space Critical (< 10% Free)
summary: Prevent application crash from full volume.
steps: Identify mount point and largest consumers (WinDirStat / du)
Check for runaway logs, dumps, or backup staging
Compress or archive per retention policy
Expand volume (VMware/Hyper-V grow + OS extend)
Verify monitoring alert threshold after cleanup
Root-cause: log rotation, backup path, temp files

title: VMware Host Hardware Alarm
summary: Host degradation — plan evacuation before failure.
steps: Review vCenter alarm — memory, CPU, storage, PSU, fan
Check CIM/health sensors and vendor support case status
vMotion workloads off host if HA capacity allows
Enter maintenance mode before hardware service
Validate cluster HA/DRS compliance after evacuation
Schedule firmware/driver update if advisory applies

title: DNS Resolution Failure
summary: Wide impact — apps and auth may fail together.
steps: Test recursive vs authoritative (nslookup/dig from client and server)
Verify DNS service running on all DCs / BIND nodes
Check forwarders and root hints
Review recent zone or conditional forwarder changes
Flush client cache; verify DHCP option 006
Escalate to network if upstream firewall blocking 53/853

title: Failed Patch Deployment — Rollback
summary: Restore service after bad patch cycle.
steps: Stop further deployment ring expansion
Identify affected OS/build and KB/package list
Windows: uninstall KB or restore snapshot / checkpoint
Linux: yum/dnf history undo or snapshot revert
Validate application smoke tests on pilot group
Open problem ticket with vendor if widespread
Update patch exemption list until root cause known

title: Database Connection Pool Exhausted
summary: App timeouts — often cascade to full outage.
steps: Check active sessions vs max_connections
Identify blocking queries and long transactions
Kill runaway sessions per approval policy
Restart app pool / service if leak suspected
Review connection string pooling settings
Scale read replica or increase pool temporarily
Schedule code review for connection leaks

title: F5 Pool Member Down
summary: Traffic may be imbalanced or failing over.
steps: Check pool member status and health monitor logs
SSH to member — verify service listening on monitor port
Compare monitor path vs actual app health endpoint
Disable bad member; confirm remaining capacity
Review recent deploy or cert change on pool
Re-enable after fix; watch connection counts
